title: Foreland
summary: FO'RELAND, noun A promontory or cape; a point of land extending into the sea some distance from the line of the shore; a head land; as the North and South foreland in Kent, in England.

inlines.v: FO'RELAND, noun A promontory or cape; a point of land extending into the sea some distance from the line of the shore; a head land; as the North and South foreland in Kent, in England.
